# lean-pkg lease list

held leases, soonest expiry first; read-only.

Also spelled: `lean-pkg leases` ([all aliases](aliases.md)).

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg lease list [--agent AGENT] [--expiring HOURS] [common flags]
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--agent AGENT` | only leases held by this agent |
| `--expiring HOURS` | only leases that lapse within HOURS (or have already lapsed) |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `leases` | held leases, soonest expiry first, with `live` / `EXPIRED` state and a last `CONTACT` column (blank when the lease has none); `--json` rows carry `contact` (null when unset); read-only | `[--agent A]` `[--expiring HOURS]` (HOURS >= 0; a negative window exits 2) |

## JSON output

Top-level keys of `--json`, as recorded in the golden contract (tests/golden/json-keys.json):

- `leases` (exit 0): `leases`, `now`, `ok`

## Examples

Your own leases that lapse within two hours, the ones to renew.

```bash
lean-pkg lease list --agent alice --expiring 2
```
